messages.subject: Slider Input Question
parts:
I would like to add a slider input to my app that would serve the purpose of adjusting the y axis range on the chart.
 
I am struggling finding a solutiion to reference the slider values in the plotting call. How would I reference the two values to mass a lower and upper limit to the plotting call?
 
eg. if the slider was set to a range of 0 to 100...how would I pass those two values to the coord_cartesisan(ylim = c(lower_slider_value, upper_slider_value))?
 
Any help is appreciated.

messages.author: 66aaf5d139ba9c7f
messages.subject: Re: Slider Input Question
parts:
Lets say your 'range' slider is called myrange 

sliderInput("myrange", "Range:",
                min = 1, max = 1000, value = c(200,500)),

then in server.R you should be able to access the range values with input$myrange[1] and input$myrange[2]. I assume you can change lower_slider_value to input$myrange[1]

However, you could also use indexing on the data.frame, e.g., dat <- mydata[input$myrange[1]:input$myrange[2],] and then feed dat to ggplot
